title: HushWriteVoicePack
description: Schema definition for HushWrite community domain voice packs.

name.description: The human-readable name of the voice pack.

author.description: GitHub handle or name of the pack author.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the vocabulary, macros, and formatting included.

vocabulary.description: List of domain terms with phonetic spellings and biasing weights.

term.description: The exact written output term (e.g. 'TypeScript' or 'SOAP note').

bias_weight.description: Initial prompt biasing weight (1.0 = normal, 1.5 = high priority).

abbreviations.description: Spoken abbreviations and their expanded forms.

voice_snippets.description: Spoken voice macros expanding to structured multi-line templates.

system_prompt_addon.description: Optional instructions injected into the local LLM cleanup pass.
